Last refreshed: 2025-02-07
Notes:
- This is a working inventory for taxonomy v1 clustering. Rows include incidents from 2024-11-01 through 2025-02-06 (covers most of 2024 Q4 + 2025 Q1 to date).
- “Candidate_category_v1” is the proposed incident taxonomy bucket (may differ from initial classification).
- “Cluster_id” is an analyst-assigned grouping for trend analysis; cluster dictionary is in Tab 2.
- TTM = time-to-mitigate (to stop customer-impacting behavior); TTR = time-to-recover/resolve (stable + verified) as captured in postmortem or IC timeline.

TAB 3 — NOTES / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Category boundary: “Capacity exhaustion” vs “Routing overload/imbalance”
  - Proposed rule of thumb for v1 labeling:
    - If pool is at max capacity / autoscaler cannot add nodes quickly enough AND routing is behaving as expected -> Capacity exhaustion / Fleet provisioning failure.
    - If routing policy or smart-routing weights concentrate traffic and create localized overload while other pools have headroom -> Routing overload/imbalance.
- Owner mapping pain points seen in rows:
  - C-FLEET-01: symptoms appear Runtime-owned but root is host/driver; incident bot should ask for “suspected layer” AND “impacted service” to drive ownership suggestion.
  - C-EDGE-02: streaming disconnects often bounce between Edge and Runtime; need a clear symptom-based rubric (RST/HTTP2 vs worker crash).
- Proposed required fields for incident bot (derived from this sheet): surface (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), customer_tier, region(s), impacted_service(s), candidate_category_v1, final_owner_team, contributing_factors (multi-select), TTM/TTR.
- Data gaps to fix in tooling:
  - Consistent incident_id format (some legacy incidents use PagerDuty incident numbers).
  - Ensure postmortem_link and slack_thread_ref are always captured.
  - Region field should support multiple regions consistently (separator standard).
- Next step:
  - Expand inventory to include 2024-08 through 2024-10 (to truly cover “last 2–3 quarters”) or explicitly scope to 90 days for backfill milestone (ENG-4826).
  - Run a 30-minute review with Platform/Infra/Runtime on cluster dictionary to sign off on boundaries before taxonomy v1 is frozen.
